findings.evidence: `Subgroup.MapSubtype.orderIso K` in `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Ker.lean:531` identifies subgroups of `K` with the interval below `K`, so both directions are equally canonical; the file documentation itself calls the conditions equivalent.
findings.fix: Replace it with an iff theorem taking `hHK : H ≤ K`, characterizing `IsCoatom (H.subgroupOf K) ↔ H ⋖ K`, and use its forward direction in the block theorem.
findings.issue: `CovBy.isCoatom_subgroupOf` states only one direction of the natural interval-lattice equivalence.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupAction/Basic.lean:143` already supplies `IsPretransitive G (orbit G B)`, and the proof establishes `(orbit G B).Nontrivial` at line 128 before converting it to the quotient-indexed presentation.
findings.fix: State and prove the result as `IsPreprimitive G (orbit G B)`.
findings.issue: The primitive block-system theorem uses the implementation-heavy carrier `orbitRel.Quotient.orbit (Quotient.mk'' B)` instead of the natural type of translates `orbit G B`.
